subject: gk
question: In 1929, Bhagat Singh and one of his associates threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly in Delhi to protest the implementation of which of the following Acts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Defence of India Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bhagat Singh and Batukeshwar Dutt threw a bomb in the Central Legislative Assembly on **April 8, 1929**, to protest against the Defence of India Act.
 
• The Defence of India Act was enacted in **1915** during World War I, granting the British government extensive powers to suppress revolutionary activities.
 
• The protest aimed to highlight the repressive measures of the British government and to draw attention to the political situation in India.
 
• Bhagat Singh and Dutt's act was intended to make a loud noise to awaken the British government and the masses, rather than cause casualties; hence, they threw harmless bombs and surrendered voluntarily.
 
• This act of defiance made Bhagat Singh a national hero and a symbol of the fight against British colonial rule in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rowlatt Act:**

 
 
• Enacted in 1919, this act allowed the British government to imprison any person suspected of terrorism without trial for up to two years.
 
• It led to widespread protests in India, including the Jallianwala Bagh massacre.
 
 
 
• **Vernacular Press Act:**
 
 
• Passed in 1878, this act aimed to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press.
 
• It was enacted by Lord Lytton to suppress criticism of British policies.
 
 
 
• **Child Marriage Restraint Act:**
 
 
• Also known as the Sarda Act, it was passed in 1929 to prohibit child marriages in India.
 
• It set the minimum age of marriage for girls at 14 years and for boys at 18 years.
 
 
 
• **Key Revolutionary Figures:**
 
 
• Bhagat Singh: A prominent revolutionary who played a key role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• Batukeshwar Dutt: An associate of Bhagat Singh, known for his role in the Assembly bombing.
